|game_text=Once per game, may ▲ [[Jawa Blaster]] or a card with "sandcrawler" in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Rtic_Hweei.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"), page 2, slip 6 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game, may ▲ Jawa Blaster or a card with "sandcrawler" in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-rtichweei-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Rtic_Hweei.png]]) print it. The dedication line “In memory of Eric White, 1983 - 2011” printed under the text box is not game text (see the dedication field). The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 13) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]], the same words).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=13, page 13. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) rewrote the text (“take one … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” for the ▲, “If present at a Tatooine battleground, once per turn,” moved first, “Force” → “card”, “you” dropped)<ref name="cl-1281_6-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Once per game, may take one Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or gametext into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If present at a Tatooine battleground, once per turn, if there is more than 1 card in opponent's Force Pile, may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Rtic_Hweei-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 13)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Once per game, may ▲ Jawa Blaster or a card with "sandcrawler" in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-6-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-rtichweei-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Once per game, may ▲ Jawa Blaster or a card with "sandcrawler" in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
